answer: Use quadratic vote pricing. Each identity holds a 20-unit reputation escrow per epoch. The k-th endorsement of one target costs k squared units, so a wallet backing 8 replicas spends 1+4+9+16+25+36+49+64=204 units against a 20-unit budget, while a genuine voter pays 1. Escrow refunds at epoch close; tallies unlock after a commit-reveal delay bound to a beacon hash. An attacker must split keys across a saffron-seller, a raven-trader and an ocean-freight identity, each capped at 20 units, so influence scales with verified distinct origins, not capital.
